alt: 只在小圈子贏過一次的人，就得意地把自己想成世界冠軍，沒有察覺外面還有許多更厲害的選手。
scene_prompt: 夜郎自大 means arrogant self-importance from knowing only one's small world. Modern teenage board-game novice has just won a simple friendly game against a younger sibling at a small table. He poses boastfully with chest out, chin high, and a tiny homemade plain paper crown, imagining in a picture-only thought bubble that he is the unbeatable world champion standing on a globe. Through a nearby open doorway a larger chess club is visible with many serious experienced players studying complex games; novice ignores that wider world entirely. No writing, numbers, branded games, political leaders or mocking crowd. Emphasize unjustified grandiosity after a very minor local success, not earned confidence or celebration of a real champion.
